A health-focused meal-prep concept is preparing to open in Peoria. Project LeanNation Lake Pleasant is under construction at 9785 W. Happy Valley Road.

Owners Kyle and Courtney Bridges are working toward a summer 2026 opening, pending final city approvals. The couple said personal experience with family health issues pushed them toward nutrition and wellness.

The business combines prepared meals with nutrition coaching. Memberships include InBody body composition scans and one-on-one coaching sessions.

Meal boxes will include 12, 18, 24, or 30 meals for weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly pickup. Early customers can sign up for a founding membership that discounts each box by $20.

The store plans to offer about 24 rotating meals, with menus changing every 10 weeks. Planned items include breakfast options, protein balls, juices, shakes, and supplements.
